<?php

use Illuminate\Routing\Controllers\HasMiddleware;
use Illuminate\Routing\Controllers\Middleware;

class CatalogController implements HasMiddleware
{
    public static function middleware(): array
    {
        return [new Middleware('auth', only: ['store'])];
    }

    public function index(): string
    {
        return 'catalog';
    }

    public function store(): string
    {
        return 'stored';
    }
}

    'channels' => [

<?php

use Illuminate\Auth\Access\Gate;
use Illuminate\Auth\GenericUser;

$current = new GenericUser(['id' => 2]);
$other = new GenericUser(['id' => 1]);
$gate = new Gate(app(), fn () => $current);
$gate->define('approve', fn ($user) => $user->id === 1);

echo json_encode([
    $gate->forUser($other)->allows('approve'),
    $gate->allows('approve'),
]);

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Event;

class Opened
{
}

class Closed
{
}

class SessionSubscriber
{
    public function opened(Opened $event): void
    {
        echo 'O';
    }

    public function closed(Closed $event): void
    {
        echo 'C';
    }

    public function subscribe($events): array
    {
        return [
            Opened::class => 'opened',
            Closed::class => 'closed',
        ];
    }
}

Event::subscribe(SessionSubscriber::class);
Event::dispatch(new Closed());

use Illuminate\Mail\Mailable;

use Illuminate\Mail\Mailables\Content;

class NoticeMail extends Mailable

            subject: 'Notice',
        );
    }

    public function content(): Content
    {
        return new Content(view: 'mail.notice');
    }
}
